title: feat(keyrack): healthcheck the keys keyrack holds
description:
## .what

extend keyrack to healthcheck the keys it holds: verify each key is accepted by its provider (not
expired, not revoked), at unlock or on demand (e.g. `rhx keyrack status --healthcheck`).

## .why

a rejected or expired provider key today surfaces only as a test failure deep in a ci shard.
declapract-typescript-ehmpathy considered a ci preflight job (#585) and ruled it out: key health
belongs to the test suite authors or to keyrack, never to ci (`rule.forbid.key-health-checks-in-cicd`).
keyrack holds the keys, so it is the right owner of a healthcheck that catches a stale key before
any run, on every machine.

## .shape of the fix

- per key, a cheap provider call that proves acceptance (e.g. a models list for an llm key)
- report each key as accepted, rejected, or unchecked (no probe known for its provider)
- name the fix on rejection: the `keyrack fill` command for that key

source: ehmpathy/declapract-typescript-ehmpathy#585
